messages:
Maya: Quick proposal — small pilot: give new workshop attendees a 50-token "starter boost" + a 3-prompt pack. Goal: lift 7-day activation (>=5 API calls or complete 1 chat path).

Jon: Sounds good. Recommend three arms: control / email-only / email + in-app overlay & auto-insert prompts. Clean attribution. :white_check_mark:

Elaine: Routing plan — send confirmation email to registrants with claim link. Signed-in RSVPs get an in-product banner; attendees who redeem hit a lightweight landing that preloads the prompt pack.

Sam (growth): I'll randomize at RSVP and create cohorts in Amplitude. Event list I need: workshop_registered, workshop_attended, starter_claimed (prop: arm), first_api_call, prompt_used (prop: template_id), overlay_shown, overlay_action. Also add utm_campaign + utm_variant props.

devex-bot: Ops note — promo tokens single-use, TTL 14d. Use POST /promo/generate with marketing-scoped key. Landing pattern: /starter/claim/<code>. Landing should fire starter_claimed and redirect to /quickstart?preload=promptpack_id.

Maya: Proposed arms in-thread: A baseline, B email-only, C email + banner + overlay (overlay shows 3 exemplar prompts + "Run one now" CTA). Measure 7 & 14 day activation + retention.

Jon: Email subject guidance — avoid "free". Draft options: "Your Redwood starter toolkit" or "Starter toolkit: templates + tokens". Elaine, can you draft 2 variants?

Elaine: Yup. I'll drop short + example-led copy to the marketing drive and tag legal for TTL language. Will also prepare banner short/long variants.

Sam (growth): I'll post sample-size estimates and tentative funnel targets by EOD Friday (rough targets: arm C claim rate 15-22%, arm B 7-10%, baseline 2-4%).

Maya: Checklist: Amplitude spec (Sam), promo generation & key (devex-bot), claim landing + analytics (devex-bot), email + banners (Elaine), prompt pack + 3 prompts (Maya), legal signoff.

Jon: I'll QA email + banner on Thursday. Schedule a 20m sync after Elaine posts drafts. :thumbsup:
